text:
Lena: Quick sync on gracepath consolidation + new 'pin sculpting' idea — we need to decide for cohort B onboards next sprint. TL;DR: propose merging 30d & 90d grace tiers into a single 60d default and enable a server-side 'pin sculpting' job that gradually reduces pinned-version exposure for low-usage tenants. Thoughts? :thinking:

Raj: Sounds interesting. From runtime side the sculpting job is doable but we need to define safe heuristics. Main concerns: cache warming regressions and KV cache eviction patterns. Can we scope to tenants under X qps and with stable eval pass rates?

Chris: Ops concerns: any automated shrinking of pins is a rollback risk if we accidentally evict a tenant relying on pinned behavior. We should require a canary window and a fast rollback path. Also need tracing hooks per-tenant.

Amanda: Product asks — what are the launch criteria? My strawman: (1) bench delta < 3% on critical prompts in canary; (2) rollback < 15min; (3) comm doc + opt-out flow. Also need to confirm billing implications for reserved vs hosted tenants.

Sylvia: Customer perspective: some enterprise customers treat pins as contracts. We'll need an exceptions flow and legal-approved wording. For SMBs this could be automatic opt-in with clear UX.

Raj: Proposed rollout plan (short):
1) Implement 'pin_sculpting' feature-flagged (default off)
2) Canary to 5 internal tenants + 3 low-usage external tenants
3) Run for 7 days with eval harness and traffic shadowing
4) If metrics good, enable soft-ttl buckets (60d) for cohort B

Sample config we discussed for canary (pseudo):
```json
{
  "pin_sculpting": {
    "enabled": true,
    "usage_threshold_tokens": "500000",
    "min_retention_days": "14",
    "default_grace_days": "60",
    "canary_tenants": ["t-internal-1","t-internal-2"],
    "rollback_sla_mins": "15"
  }
}
```

Chris: +1 to the plan. Add a monitoring alert for increased regen latency and model mismatch rate. We should also capture sample outputs for offline QA.

Amanda: Also add acceptance gate: before enabling globally, product needs benchmark report comparing pinned vs sculpted for the top 10 customer prompt slices and an approved comm template. I'll owner the comm template.

Lena: Good. Action items: Raj implements feature-flag and local sims (owner: Raj, due EOD Thu), Chris adds alerts & rollback script (owner: Chris, due Fri), Amanda drafts comm + acceptance doc (owner: Amanda, due Mon), Sylvia to collect enterprise exception list (owner: Sylvia, due Mon). I'll book a 30m follow-up next Tue to review canary metrics.

ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled: pin-sculpting/feature-flag branch -> staging at 2026-03-27T03:00Z (dry-run).

Lena: Thanks all. If anyone sees a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:
